newsletter.subject: Larkspur Robotics lands $40M
newsletter.text:
Good morning, builders.

Larkspur Robotics, the maker of shelf-picking robots for mid-sized warehouses, has raised a $40 million Series B led by Tidewater Ventures. Existing backer Halcyon Fund also joined the round.

Larkspur says its robots now run in 85 customer warehouses, up from 30 a year ago. The company plans to use the money to hire 120 engineers and open a second office in Port Avalon.

Founder Mira Castellan told us the hardest part is still the last few centimeters: getting a gripper to pick a soft bag without crushing it.

Read the full interview: https://seedsheet.example/larkspur
